title: Image pricing updated; GPT Image configuration refreshed
summary:
Image pricing and GPT Image configuration changed while the community catalog grew and the model monitor got more honest about 4xx errors.

Per-image prices were updated for Flux, Z-Image, Klein, and Klein-Large, with an accompanying Enter news banner. The image service also received updated GPT Image 1 Mini and GPT Image 1.5 resource configurations. A follow-up removed an inaccurate tier claim from the banner.

New listings span a Seedance video generator, image and avatar tools, multimodal chat workspaces, a Telegram image bot, study tools, developer tools, and a browser extension. The app-submission badge also now uses the Pollinations logo instead of a placeholder.

The monitor now excludes 4xx responses from its primary request count, success rate, and request-based sorting. It still shows the raw request total in parentheses, so client errors remain visible without counting against model success.

highlights.title: More community creative tools
highlights.text: Find a Seedance video generator, one-click SillyTavern avatars, and a chat workspace for text, images, and video among the new community listings. [Explore community apps](https://pollinations.ai).
